summary.text: Customers find these gingerbread man ornaments cute and perfect for tree decorations, with vibrant colors and good value for money. The size receives mixed feedback - while some say they're good for decorating, others note they're smaller than expected. The durability and material quality are also mixed, with some finding them durable and made of rubber-like material, while others report they're not very durable and made of cheap gummy rubber.

Very cute, but small. Back not decorative. Should be sold at dollar store- all 12 for a dollar. Or took me 1/2 hour to tie strings on for hanging.
I really like them. They are small and adorable. I didn’t use the strings that came with them, as I couldn’t tie them well. I used hooks....
